objects.description: Extends STIX 2.1 with features to create Attack Flows.

objects.name: Detection technique coverage: crowdstrike-privilege-escalation-for-non-admin-user
objects.description: The following analytic detects CrowdStrike alerts for privilege escalation attempts by non-admin users. These alerts indicate unauthorized efforts by regular users to gain elevated permissions, posing a significant security risk. Detecting and addressing these attempts promptly helps prevent potential breaches and ensures that user privileges remain properly managed, maintaining the integrity of the organization's security protocols.
